quantitative_quotes.result: Quoted model/quantile figures match source aggregate tables, with selected-population and observational limitations retained

findings.finding: Hybrid32 requires a qualified same-state K=3 ensemble. Original 40-fit plan counted only endpoint fits, not 20 additional acquisition member fits at 10 new-CW states.
findings.recommended_fix: Use raw Gradient-LCMD32 for the minimum 4-arm screen, or explicitly add ensemble fitting cost. Replacing raw with Hybrid adds 20 fits for one round / 60 for three; adding a fifth Hybrid arm adds endpoint fits too, totaling +30 / +90.
findings.current_status: RESOLVED: minimum screen uses raw Gradient-LCMD32; Hybrid replacement +20/+60 and fifth-arm addition +30/+90 fits stated explicitly.

findings.finding: Two fixed-label models can test whether conditional signal is learnable; they cannot identify irreducible noise versus missing variables. Both models failing is not a noise estimate.
findings.recommended_fix: Describe experiment 1 as a test of learnable condition signal. Require verified replicate metadata or repeated measurements to estimate measurement variability; preserve failure as inconclusive.
findings.current_status: RESOLVED: synthesis now states condition learnability test does not identify irreducible noise; replicate metadata/repeated measurement needed.

findings.finding: Removing held-out pairs from L525/L1005 changes effective training size and excludes reuse of historical checkpoints that saw those pairs. Shared endpoints and same-condition duplicates must be held out together.
findings.recommended_fix: Report actual |L_t minus H|. Prefer H from acquired L_t minus L333 and exclude condition groups overlapping L333, to retain the original target-scale convention without held-out-response scaling. Refit both arms from scratch, pairing shared-layer initialization.
findings.current_status: RESOLVED: actual |L_t minus H|; whole-pair and identical-condition grouping; scratch refit/no checkpoint reuse; H restricted to L_t minus L333 and no overlapping L333 condition groups; metadata-only minimum 10 isolated pair-group feasibility gate, otherwise no execution or response-driven state substitution.
